source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=True, free, best-effort)
method: Generate peer-sector combinations; 252 completed formation sessions excluding observation; 90-return correlation; Engle-Granger trend=c autolag=AIC when r>0.50; 60-residual Z; BH FDR across every enumerated hypothesis (untested p=1); positive beta and <=30% half-window beta drift.
warnings: Exploratory multiple-comparison scan, not an independently validated trading edge.
Yahoo historical adjusted closes are vendor estimates, not certified executable quotes.
No walk-forward net-of-cost/borrow/earnings validation or automatic orders.
Weekends and market holidays repeat the most recent completed session.
Before 17:00 America/New_York, any current-day daily candle is excluded as potentially incomplete.
New means first qualified since this daily history began, not a recommendation.

input_provenance.provider: Yahoo Finance via yfinance auto_adjust=True; third-party data not independently certified
input_provenance.method: Normalized price input downloaded once for scanning and deep reviews; CSV gzip checksum uses uncompressed UTF-8
